notes.title: Movement Speed Update
notes.content:
[h1]Movement Update[/h1]

Someone suggested that the movement speed of the player airplane should be slower to enable smooth bullet dodging.  In response to this i've added the functionality to switch between full speed, quarter speed and half speed.  Below are the button bindings:

[h3]JOYPAD[/h3]
Left Trigger (HOLD) - Quarter Speed
Right Trigger (HOLD) - Half Speed

[h3]KEYBOARD[/h3]
Q - Quarter Speed (On/Off Toggle)
E - Half Speed (On/Off Toggle)

tags.feature: In response to this i've added the functionality to switch between full speed, quarter speed and half speed.

notes.title: STEAM leaderboards and live in game global rank retrieval added
notes.content:
I've added STEAM leaderboards to the game now so your highscore posts to the leaderboard if any of the following conditions are true:

1. You die
2. You pause / exit
3. you finish a level

While you're playing the game i've also added a rank system which displays your global rank for your high score and also your current game score.  This also displays player 2s rank if you are playing co-operative local multiplayer.

The game is shaping up quite nicely now and i intend to add much more content if there is enough support from the shmup community.

Show your support by wish listing the game please.....
If i get enough wish lists i'll release a 2 level playable demo of the game. ;-)

Thanks
Paul (part time solo indie)
